messages:
Dana: observed attach backlog in eu-west2 at 09:12, about 88 pending. dashboard shows node-level iowait spikes.
Wei: which nodes? any SMART or nvme errors reported?
Dana: sampled gnode-eu-33-04 and gnode-eu-33-06. kernel shows repeated metadata checksum warnings and scrub kickoffs.
Dana: ```
[ 6789.001234] nvme0: metadata checksum mismatch, namespace 1
[ 6789.002000] nvme-core: media error, retrying command
[ 6790.100500] scrubber: enqueue deep-scrub job for extent 0xabc123
```
Rafael: timeline: we pushed a tempfile janitor concurrency increase last night and a scrub scheduler tweak earlier this morning. looks like lockstep maintenance + a thermal hotspot causing IO collapse.
Wei: short-term: throttle scrub concurrency to 1 for the affected node group, suspend tempfile sweep CronJob in eu-west2 for 20m, and enable attach routing fallback to the cache-only pool for non-pinned workloads.
Dana: will run commands.
Dana: ```
# reduce scrub concurrency on eu-west2 scrubber daemonset
kubectl -n storage set env daemonset/scrubber SCRUB_CONCURRENCY=1 --context=prod-eu-west2
# suspend janitor tempfile sweeps for eu-west2
kubectl -n janitor patch cronjob/tempfile-sweep -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}' --context=prod-eu-west2
# set routing override to prefer cache-only pool for 30m
redwoodctl routing override --region eu-west2 --prefer cache-only --duration 30m
```
ops-bot: scrubber concurrency reduced; tempfile-sweep CronJob suspended; routing override active.
Rafael: quick signal: pending attaches dropped from 88 -> 26 in ~90s, iowait falling but still some controllers reporting retries.
Wei: follow-ups: 1) run a nondestructive nvme-verify on those drives, 2) schedule vendor firmware correlation check for the cohort, 3) implement a short-lived circuit-breaker in maintenance controller to avoid running deep-scrub + janitor concurrently on the same AZ.
Dana: I'll kick off verify and open the vendor case with serials. posting verify command in the runbook.
Dana: ```
# nondestructive verify (runs background verify pass)
storage-tool verify --device /dev/nvme0n1 --non-destructive --report /tmp/verify-gnode-eu-33-04.log
```
Rafael: we'll also add a transient alert that escalates if corrupt extents > 2 within 1h. if verifies show progressive errors, we'll retire the nodes preemptively.
ops-bot: alert suppression set for NVMe IOPS surge in eu-west2 for 15m while mitigation in effect.
infra-oncall: acknowledged. monitoring dashboards and will prepare host retirement play if verify fails.
Wei: also recommend a small RB to gate scrub concurrency based on node iowait > 60% and to lower janitor threadpool during high writeback. will draft now.
Dana: thanks all. will post verify results here and mark hosts for replacement if errors increase. :thumbsup:
